title: Why Major Stock Indices Don’t Care About Rates
summary: One of the questions plaguing investors in recent weeks is why major stock indices have been able to rally to new highs even as interest rates reach levels that have not been seen for decades. Yesterday, a concise answer to that question occurred to me during a conversation with a reporter.
